checks.text: The page displays the heading "CSV Viewer" and the text "Drop a CSV file or click to browse" in the empty state.
After loading a CSV with header "Name,Age,City" and one row "Alice,30,Paris", the DataGrid shows a column header "Name" and the cell value "Alice" in the first data row.
Typing "Alice" in the input labelled "Filter" and pressing Enter filters the grid to show only the row containing "Alice"; the row count indicator shows "1 of 1 rows".
Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file named "export.csv" containing the text "Name,Age,City\nAlice,30,Paris".
Clicking the button "Clear Filter" removes the filter text from the input labelled "Filter" and the grid shows all rows again; the row count indicator shows "1 of 1 rows".

After loading a CSV with two rows "Alice,30,Paris" and "Bob,25,London", clicking the cell containing "Bob" selects it; pressing the Down arrow key moves the selection to the next row, and the cell containing "Alice" in the second row is now selected.
Clicking the button "Reset" clears the loaded file and returns the page to the empty state showing "Drop a CSV file or click to browse".

Reload keeps the loaded CSV data and the active filter: after loading "Name,Age,City" with row "Alice,30,Paris" and filtering by "Alice", reloading the page still shows the grid with "Alice" and the filter input contains "Alice".
